scripts.audio:generate: npm run audio:music && npm run audio:room-tone
scripts.render:voice: npm run audio:room-tone && remotion render src/index.jsx FigmaHandDrawnNarrated out/figma-multiplayer-voice.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:youtube: npm run audio:generate && remotion render src/index.jsx FigmaHandDrawnNarratedMusic out/figma-multiplayer-youtube-1080p.mp4 --codec=h264 --scale=1.5 --video-bitrate=8M --audio-bitrate=320K --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --image-format=png --x264-preset=slow --gop-size=12 --overwrite
scripts.render:short: npm run audio:music && remotion render src/index.jsx FigmaMultiplayerShort out/figma-multiplayer-short.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
